datasets.name: Southwest landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: Therefore, we gathered another available landslide dataset to enrich the diversity and robustness of landslide data (https://github.com/YhQIAO/LandSlide_Detection_Faster-RCNN), which is named Southwest landslide dataset.

methods.name: LS-YOLO
methods.summary: A landslide detection model based on YOLOv5s, incorporating a multiscale feature extraction (MSFE) module in the neck and an improved decoupled head with a context enhancement module (CEM) using dilated convolutions for the regression branch.
methods.verbatim: The code and MSLD will be available at https://github.com/wenjieo/LS-YOLO.

reproducibility_assessment: The Southwest landslide dataset is linked and publicly available via GitHub. The custom LS-YOLO code is provided via a persistent repository link.
